queries.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery_soc")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "bems_live_zendure_live")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery_actual_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "bems_live_zendure_live")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "meter_household_dlms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery_actual_power" or r["_measurement"] == "heat_pump_power" or r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power" or r["_measurement"] == "pv_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _value: if r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power"
      then r["_value"] * 1.0
      else  if r["_measurement"] == "pv_power"
      then r["_value"] * 0.001
      else r["_value"]
  }))
  |> yield(name: "mean")

meter =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -20s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "meter_household_dlms")
        |> group()
        |> last()
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            _time: "meter_time",
            _value: "meter"
        })
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "latest"}))

pv =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -20s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pv_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "inverter_fronius")
        |> group()
        |> last()
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            _time: "pv_time",
            _value: "pv"
        })
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "latest"}))

battery =
    from(bucket: "home")
        |> range(start: -20s)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery_actual_power")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "bems_live_zendure_live")
        |> group()
        |> last()
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
        |> rename(columns: {
            _time: "battery_time",
            _value: "battery"
        })
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "latest"}))

meter_pv =
    join(
        tables: {meter: meter, pv: pv},
        on: ["joinKey"],
        method: "inner"
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        joinKey: r.joinKey,
        meter: r.meter,
        pv: r.pv,
        meter_time: r.meter_time,
        pv_time: r.pv_time
    }))

join(
    tables: {power: meter_pv, battery: battery},
    on: ["joinKey"],
    method: "inner"
)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: if r.meter_time > r.pv_time then
            (if r.meter_time > r.battery_time then r.meter_time else r.battery_time)
        else
            (if r.pv_time > r.battery_time then r.pv_time else r.battery_time),
        _value: r.meter + r.pv * 0.001 - r.battery,
        _measurement: "total_household_power"
    }))
    |> yield(name: "total_household_power")

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "heat_pump_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "calculated")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "battery_command_requested_power" or r["_measurement"] == "battery_actual_power" or r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "meter_grid_dlms" or r["source"] == "meter_household_dlms" or r["source"] == "bems_live_zendure_live")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._measurement == "battery_actual_power"
          then r._value / -1.0
          else r._value
  }))
   |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._measurement == "battery_command_requested_power"
          then r._value / -1.0
          else r._value
  }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: if r._measurement == "battery_soc"
          then r._value / 10.0
          else r._value
  }))
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "grid_active_power")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["source"] == "meter_grid_dlms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")
